problem: The continuous proactive source-pool implementation is materially narrower than the canonical ASI discovery architecture: live execution currently uses only Wikidata Action API, Wikidata official-website claims and DataCite DOI metadata, creating systematic discovery bias and under-coverage for a global collectibles intelligence platform.
root_cause: A bounded pilot implementation was promoted into the recurring discovery loop without expanding to the already-defined multi-channel discovery architecture.
closure_rule: DETECT -> CONTAIN -> ROOT_CAUSE -> CORRECT -> REGRESSION_PROOF -> CANONICAL_TRUTH_SYNC -> CLOSE

rollout.goal: Broaden global candidate-domain/site discovery without acquiring target-site content.
Increase regional/venue/category recall while keeping target traversal and admission fail-closed.
Use only after explicit rights/account/EULA/spend authorization; never a mandatory bottleneck.

exit_criteria: Recurring proactive loop executes all Wave A channels or records explicit channel-specific HOLD reasons.
Candidate pool reports coverage by category x macroregion x discovery channel.
No candidate is promoted to rights/admission/evidence by discovery frequency alone.
Channel-removal and provider-failure tests prove graceful degradation without global discovery collapse.
Current-main regression validates global discovery breadth and fail-closed rights boundaries.
